description: The parametric model of a part (`model.json` inside a `.sltwx`; docs/specs/FILE_FORMAT.md). Readers keep unknown fields, so no object is closed. The reference reader is `read_unpacked` in crates/swx-io.

bodies.description: The solid bodies the features create. Each element is an object with a non-empty string `id`. IDs are unique within this array and Written sorted by `id`. A schema cannot express uniqueness or order; `swx-io` enforces both when reading and writing.

end_of_part.description: The `id` of the last feature that is rebuilt (the rollback position).

features.description: The feature history, in rebuild order. Each element is an object with a non-empty string `id`. IDs are unique within this array and Written in history order, not sorted. A schema cannot express uniqueness or order; `swx-io` enforces both when reading and writing.

origin.description: The origin point, axes and planes of the part.

parameters.description: The parameter table: named expressions that drive dimensions and features.

sketches.description: The sketches of the part. Each element is an object with a non-empty string `id`. IDs are unique within this array and Written sorted by `id`. A schema cannot express uniqueness or order; `swx-io` enforces both when reading and writing.

constraints.description: The sketch's constraints and dimensions. Each element is an object with a non-empty string `id`. IDs are unique within this array and Written sorted by `id`. A schema cannot express uniqueness or order; `swx-io` enforces both when reading and writing.

entities.description: The sketch's geometry (points, lines, arcs, circles). Each element is an object with a non-empty string `id`. IDs are unique within this array and Written sorted by `id`. A schema cannot express uniqueness or order; `swx-io` enforces both when reading and writing.
